hypotheses.U1_unseen_words_transfer: For at least four of five families, the FineWeb-frozen native mode, signal, orientation, and pole reach unseen-word AUROC at least 0.70 at offset zero on both TinyStories and WikiText-103.
hypotheses.U2_native_modes_beat_random_on_unseen_wo: At offset zero, median unseen-word AUROC of the frozen native representatives exceeds the frozen isotropic-random representatives by at least 0.05 on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.U3_native_axes_beat_rotated_subspace: At offset zero, median unseen-word AUROC of the frozen native representatives exceeds frozen rotated-subspace representatives by at least 0.05 on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.U4_semantics_persist_one_token: At least three of five native representatives retain AUROC at least 0.60 one token after an unseen lexicon item on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.U5_contextual_state_beats_current_embedd: At offset one, the native Layer-3 coordinate exceeds its current-token embedding-projection baseline by at least 0.05 for at least three families on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.U6_unseen_family_labels_are_specific: At offset zero, own-family unseen-word AUROC exceeds the strongest oriented wrong-family unseen pole by at least 0.05 for at least four families on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.U7_current_token_abstraction_exceeds_emb: At offset zero, the native Layer-3 coordinate exceeds the direct current-token embedding projection by at least 0.05 in median on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.U8_increasing_scale_generalizes: The frozen increasing-scale representative reaches unseen-word AUROC at least 0.65 at offset zero on FineWeb, TinyStories, and WikiText-103.
hypotheses.U9_unseen_transfer_is_corpus_stable: For at least four families, TinyStories and WikiText-103 offset-zero unseen-word AUROCs differ by at most 0.15.
